name: AllUnity EUR
oneLiner: EURAU is AllUnity's MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against EUR held in full-reserve, segregated accounts at EU credit institutions.
collateral: Euro-denominated reserves held at CRR credit institutions within the EU, under a multi-bank full reserve model; not used for lending or investment

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: AllUnity describes EURAU as fully backed by bank reserves and provides always-on settlement. Its white paper permits EUR cash and HQLA reserves for a 1:1 euro claim, which supports the issuer-managed fiat-cash archetype rather than a CDP, NAV fund share, or algorithmic mechanism.

mintAuthority.summary: EURAU is controlled by two AllUnity EOAs across all six EVM chains (ETH, ARB, OP, Base, Polygon, BSC): EOA minter 0xd443f046 holds MINTER_ROLE and EOA 0xddaca43e holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; roles confirmed via hasRole on every chain. UUPS proxy with no ProxyAdmin on all chains. Solana, Stellar, and Tempo are issuer-backend lanes not confirmable from chain state but corroborated by the confirmed issuer-controlled minter model.

review.evidence: All six EVM chains (ETH/ARB/OP/Base/Polygon/BSC) share contract address 0x4933a85b5b5466fbaf179f72d3de273c287ec2c2. On 2026-07-21, hasRole confirmed both EOA minter (MINTER_ROLE) and EOA admin (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE), and EIP-1967 reads returned implementation 0x56c19aea2192ff0ac5f6b252776480db601a1482, at Ethereum block 25580320, Arbitrum block 486145773, Optimism block 154514391, Base block 48919106, Polygon block 90615043, and BNB Chain block 111262337. The verified implementation is UUPS and _authorizeUpgrade is gated directly by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, with no ProxyAdmin or timelock. Solana (9pCWprxbZMW2rYSMhPTeoyLMV2sN2WJqshdT7DQVt6hS), Stellar, and Tempo are issuer-backend lanes; their controller identities remain unresolved separately. Reserve review: no independent attestor, cadence, or dated reserve report is public; AllUnity's Trust Center still says the reserve audit report is coming soon as of 2026-07-21. The ESMA MiCA register and BaFin authorization match AllUnity GmbH as the EMI and EURAU EMT issuer, so prudential supervision is present but independent reconciliation remains unknown.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AllUnity says EURAU integrates Chainlink CCIP for native zero-slippage burn/mint transfers across supported chains. Because durable cross-chain supply movement depends on CCIP's external interoperability network and issuer controls, the route is scored as external-validated-network.
